tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Fetch live, normalized open job postings for one or more companies across 7 keyless ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Recruitee, Workable). Platform and board token are auto-detected from a bare slug or domain. Returns a unified schema: title, company, location, remo

tools.name: resolve_company
tools.description: Resolve which applicant-tracking system a company uses and its board token, from a bare slug or domain. Returns {platform, token, via}. Free.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List the supported ATS platforms this feed auto-detects and normalizes. Free.

tools.name: get_premium_access
tools.description: Return the paid x402 rail: the metered depth layers (hosted 10-ATS search, normalized compensation, per-company hiring-intent signal, company enrichment, email deliverability) with exact prices (USDC on Base), the pay-to address, and how the 402 flow works. No account; an x402-aware client pays inli

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "unified" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs, list_platforms, get_premium_access · Private data: search_jobs, resolve_company, get_premium_access · Public sink: get_premium_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs, list_platforms, get_premium_access · Private data: search_jobs, resolve_company, get_premium_access · Public sink: get_premium_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
